newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rugby union-Australia's Eales recalled for Springbok clash.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Australia's Eales recalled for Springbok clash.

text.p: Australia captain John Eales was named on Monday in a 24-man squad for this weekend's Tri-Nations match against South Africa but with a deadline to prove his recovery from a knee injury.
The towering lock will undergo a fitness test on ligament damage to his left knee later in the week to determine whether he will lead the Wallabies in Pretoria on Saturday.
The injury, sustained in training last week, forced Eales to miss Australia's 36-24 loss to New Zealand in Dunedin on Saturday -- a result which confirmed the All Blacks as Tri-Nations champions.
"John has a better than 50-50 chance of playing against the Springboks," an Australian Rugby Union spokesman told Reuters.
"He has been given the all-clear to leave with the rest of the team but his availability will be subject to a fitness test in South Africa," the spokesman said.
Wallaby coach Greg Smith dropped lock Garrick Morgan to make way for Eales' return, while flanker Matt Cockbain won a recall after missing the All Black clash because of mild concussion.
Should Eales fail the fitness test, flanker David Wilson was expected to retain the captaincy.
Australia must beat South Africa to avoid finishing bottom of the Tri-Nations table for a second season in succession.

Forwards - Richard Harry, Michael Foley, Andrew Heath, Andrew Blades, Marco Caputo, Owen Finegan, John Eales (captain), John Langford, Matt Cockbain, Brett Robinson, David Wilson, Troy Coker, Fili Finau, Toutai Kefu.
Backs - Stephen Larkham, Ben Tune, Joe Roff, Daniel Herbert, James Holbeck, Jason Little, Sam Payne, George Gregan, David Knox, Mitch Hardy.
